notes: Pin numbers, base names and types checked against KiCad 10 RF_Module:MDBT50Q-1MV2 and Raytac Version L pin assignment retrieved in memory. GPIO are bidirectional physical pads; assigned A03 functions are carried in names.

Pin 46 is P0.22, intentionally unused in A03; it is not a physically NC pad. Pin 31 is DCCH power_out, intentionally open in normal-voltage mode. Pin 32 VBUS remains power_in even though this USB-disabled design grounds it.
All six actual ground pads use power_in and have separate visible endpoints; no hidden stacked power pins. GPIO function and firmware direction remain separate review requirements.

ZE 8x6 package has pins 1-8 plus project-numbered exposed pad 9. EP is permitted NC or GND, so passive is intentional; A03 connects it to GND. IO0-IO3 are physically bidirectional, including WP/HOLD in quad mode; A03 firmware uses standard SPI.

Rev B Table 4-1 roles used. Open-drain outputs use KiCad open_collector. BAT both sources charging current and accepts battery power; KiCad has no power-bidirectional type, so passive is deliberate and VBAT needs an external-source power flag. EP is a thermal ground pad, numbered 11 in the authored footprint.
TS/MR, ISET and ILIM/VSET are analog bias/sense I/O according to TI. Comparator/protection validity is not proved by ERC.
DBV package, no exposed pad. Pin 4 has no internal connection and must retain the intentional NC marker.

Rev 7 page 6: MAX17048 CELL is not internally connected but manufacturer directs it to positive battery terminal. Model as passive, not no_connect, to preserve that required external connection. MAX17049 differs.
CTG and exposed pad connect GND. QSTRT is an input grounded when unused, not an NC. ALRT is open-drain; SDA bidirectional open-drain bus.

DGS pin map from TI Rev D page 5; REG is the internal 1.8 V regulator output and only bypassed. Pin 6 can be VDD or NC per datasheet; A03 explicitly ties it to VSYS with pin 10. Differential output terminals remain outputs, not power flags.
DCU pin order from TI Rev Q Table Pin Functions. Pins 3 and 6 are three-state outputs with Ioff protection; no swapped A/Y pairs.
DDC pin numbers differ from DSE. OUTA unused but remains an actual open-drain output with explicit NC marker; OUTB sinks charge-permission node.

Pins are G1/S2/D3. Source and drain are passive switch terminals; body diode anode is source 2 and cathode is drain 3. Box is an explicit pin-mapped engineering symbol; final drawing should show body diode to make polarity review easy.

DPDT commons 2 and 5. ON joins 2-1 and 5-4; OFF joins 2-3 and 5-6. Do not use a stock DPDT symbol unless its numbered commons match. Physical switch position is not modeled as a copper short in the netlist.

Knowles Rev A pages 4/9: DATA enters high impedance for multiplexed opposite half-cycles; tri_state is accurate for tied stereo DATA pins. Stock Sensor_Audio symbol uses output and can produce a false output-conflict. SELECT MK1 is GND and SELECT MK2 is MIC_VDD.

Authored PCB contacts, not purchased SMT parts. Numbers and names preserve the existing design. Battery, dock and debugger are external interfaces; do not assign power_out to every contact simply to silence ERC.

INB- above400mV sinks OUTB; falling below~394.5mV opens chargepermission. Require1ms stableVSYS before CHG_ALLOW. C18 bypass nearVDD.
Gate1 drivenMCUwithR3pulldown; source2 comparatorOUTB; drain3 active-lowchargerCE. Bodydiode source-to-drain prevents OFF drain pullinglow.

powerFlagRecommendations.basis: External dock/battery return; passive connectors cannot drive power_in.
Keyed current-limited 5 V dock supplies J1.2.
D1 Schottky forward path supplies charger IN; ERC does not infer drive through a passive diode.
Protected external rechargeable cell supplies this rail; BQ BAT is bidirectional power terminal.
SW1 ON passes regulated MIC_SUPPLY and OFF grounds the rail; flag documents conditional rail source, not constant power. Physical switching and startup require separate audit.
